svg.data-weight: 10.5 kg (23.0 lbs) for the 7280CR3-36S, 7280CR3K-36S and 7280CR3K-36A (guide Table 1, data sheet 10.47 kg)
svg.data-size-over-ears: 48.3 x 4.4 x 47.2 cm (19 x 1.75 x 18.6 in) with the mounting ears (guide Table 1)
svg.data-ports-max-speed: two ports of 400 Gbps; 40 of 100 Gbps; 80 of 50 Gbps; 36 of 40 Gbps; 120 of 25 or 10 Gbps; 24 of 1 Gbps
svg.data-power-measure: typical at 25 C ambient with 50 percent load on all ports (data sheet)
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 to 40 C (32 to 104 F); rear-to-front air is subject to 35 C maximum ambient (data sheet note 4)
svg.data-storage-temp: -25 to 70 C (guide Table 2); the data sheet says -40 to 70 C
svg.data-humidity: 5 to 90 percent non-condensing (guide Table 2); the data sheet says 5 to 95 percent
svg.data-storage: 8 GB flash (not on the 7280CR3K-36A); SSD 120 GB on the 7280CR3K-36A only
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: 100G, 50G, 40G, 25G and 10G with breakout, and 1G, in the QSFP cages (data sheet)
svg.data-optics-qsfp-dd: 400G and 200G, in the two QSFP-DD cages (data sheet)
svg.data-eos-license: license group G3; minimum EOS 4.26.1 (7280CR3-36S, CR3K-36S), 4.27.2 (7280CR3K-36A); rear-to-front air needs EOS 4.29.1
svg.data-console: RJ-45 RS-232 serial on the front, 9600 baud 8N1, no flow control
svg.data-oob: one 10/100/1000 management port on the front
svg.data-usb: one USB port on the front, for software or configuration updates
svg.data-certifications: BSMI, CE, KCC, NRTL, RCM, UKCA, VCCI, TEC, ANATEL, ICASA (data sheet)
